name: Waldmann
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Waldmann in Schwangau – a culinary gem nestled in the heart of the Alps!**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy mountain setting, where every dish tells a story of tradition and passion. Just a stone’s throw from **Neuschwanstein Castle**, our family-run restaurant invites you to savor the flavors of **Tirol** in a warm, rustic atmosphere.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** – fluffy, caramelized, and served with fresh berries or apple compote – a true masterpiece of Tyrolean baking. Pair it with a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** or a local craft beer for the perfect alpine experience.

Our menu features seasonal specialties like **Tiroler Gröstl** (a hearty potato pancake with bacon and cheese) and **Kässpatzen** (creamy potato dumplings with melted cheese), all made with the finest regional ingredients. For meat lovers, try our slow-roasted **Tiroler Schmankerl** or a juicy **Almwiesen-Rind** (Alm pasture beef).

After your meal, warm up with a **Glühwein** (mulled wine) or a steaming **Kaffee mit Schnaps** (coffee with a shot of schnapps) by the crackling fireplace. The view of the **Alps** and the sound of cowbells in the distance make every visit unforgettable.

Whether you're exploring **Schwangau**, visiting **Innsbruck**, or hiking through the **Zugspitze** region, Waldmann is your perfect stop for genuine Tyrolean cuisine and heartfelt service.

**Come taste the soul of Tirol – we’re waiting for you!**
